# Pediatric Dentistry of Central Florida

> A comprehensive pediatric dental practice in Maitland and St. Cloud, Florida offering specialized care for children from infants through adolescents.

Pediatric Dentistry of Central Florida is a full-service pediatric dental practice with multiple locations and an experienced team of pediatric dentists. The practice specializes in preventative care, restorative treatment, orthodontics, and specialized services including sedation dentistry and tongue tie laser revision for infants.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
- Preventative care
- Infant care
- Orthodontics

## Dental Services

- [Preventative Care](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/preventative-care): Preventative dental care services and children's oral health procedures
- [Infant Care](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/infant-care): Infant care dental services including baby teeth and first dental visit information
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry services including cavity treatment and dental crowns
- [Orthodontics](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/orthodontics): Orthodontics services including braces and teeth straightening for children
- [Emergency Care](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/emergency-care): Emergency dental care services for dental injuries and urgent tooth trauma
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry options including IV sedation and anesthesia for anxious children
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/special-needs-dentistry): Special needs dentistry services for children with special healthcare needs
- [Lip Tie & Tongue Tie Laser Revision](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/lip-tie-tongue-tie-laser-revision): Tongue tie and lip tie laser revision services for infant feeding support
